services.intro: We are here to help you at every moment, with a wide range of services that support you at each step of the logistics process.

logistics.text: We coordinate the transport of your cargo from anywhere in the world to its final destination, safely and reliably. With strategic local and international partnerships, we handle import, export and distribution, from the plant to the delivery, seeking the best balance of efficiency and cost.
logistics.kicker: Choose how to move your cargo

tiles.title: Ocean FCL
tiles.text: A full container for your cargo. Ideal for large volumes.

tiles.title: Ocean LCL
tiles.text: Consolidated cargo: you only pay for the space your goods take up.

tiles.title: Air
tiles.text: For urgent or high-value cargo that cannot wait.

tiles.title: Road
tiles.text: Road transport, from pickup to your destination.

tiles.title: Multimodal
tiles.text: We combine several transport modes in a single operation.

tiles.title: Door to door
tiles.text: We coordinate your shipment from origin to your address, under the customs regime that applies to your cargo.

tiles.title: Courier
tiles.text: Small, urgent shipments, handled with authorized operators.

logistics.ctaText: Not sure which one to choose? We'll help you decide.

insurance.title: International Cargo Insurance
insurance.text: We include insurance for international cargo transport with partner insurers. We offer policies so your cargo travels safely and reliably, minimizing the risks in your supply chain.

customs.title: Customs Brokerage
customs.text: We process the legal procedures before the Customs Administration to bring in and ship out your goods.
customs.note: Depending on the type and value of your cargo, we let you know whether courier or standard import applies.

advisory.title: Specialized Advisory
advisory.text: We advise you on your export, import and international logistics proposals, with personalized work plans. It includes:
items: Review of your logistics and distribution processes

needs.titleLight: What information do we need to
needs.intro: The more complete your information, the faster and more accurate the quote. If you don't have all the details yet, send us what you have and we'll help you complete the rest. These are the same fields as the form above.

essentials.title: Origin and destination
essentials.text: City and country, and the port or airport if you know it. For door to door, the pickup and delivery addresses.

essentials.title: What you are shipping
essentials.text: A clear description of the goods: what they are, what they are made of and what they are used for. If you have it, the tariff code (HS code).

essentials.title: Weight and number of packages
essentials.text: Total gross weight in kilos and the number of packages, boxes or pallets.

essentials.title: Dimensions and packaging type
essentials.text: Length × width × height of each package, and whether it ships in boxes, pallets, sacks, drums or loose pieces.

essentials.title: Goods value
essentials.text: The value per commercial invoice or proforma (in USD). We use it for insurance and to calculate customs taxes.

essentials.title: When it is ready
essentials.text: The date your supplier has the cargo ready and, if it is urgent, the deadline by which you need it at destination.

helpful.title: Delivery terms (Incoterm)
helpful.text: The one agreed with your supplier: EXW, FOB, CIF or another. It defines which part of the transport we coordinate.

helpful.title: Supplier details
helpful.text: Name, location and contact of whoever hands over the cargo, so we can coordinate the pickup.

helpful.title: Additional services
helpful.text: If you need customs brokerage, cargo insurance or delivery to your address, include it in the same quote.

helpful.title: Special cargo
helpful.text: Let us know if it is dangerous, refrigerated, fragile, oversized or high-value, so we can request the right conditions and documents.

helpful.title: Available documents
helpful.text: Commercial invoice or proforma, packing list and, if applicable, technical data sheet or MSDS.

helpful.title: Your contact details
helpful.text: Name, company, tax ID (RIF) and phone number. We already receive your email address when you write to us.

byMode.title: Depending on the shipment type, add:
byMode.intro: Choose your transport mode to see the extra detail that changes the rate.

items.title: Container type and quantity
items.text: 20', 40' or 40' HC, and how many you need.

items.title: Weight per container
items.text: The approximate weight of the cargo going in each one.

items.title: Cargo status
items.text: Whether it is ready to load at origin or needs to be consolidated first.

items.title: Total volume
items.text: In cubic meters (m³), calculated from the dimensions of each package.

items.title: Number of packages or pallets
items.text: And whether or not they can be stacked.

items.title: Total gross weight
items.text: In kilos, along with the weight of the heaviest packages.

items.title: Exact dimensions per package
items.text: Air freight is charged on the greater of actual weight and volumetric weight.

items.title: Urgency
items.text: The arrival deadline, to choose between direct and connecting options.

items.title: Restricted products
items.text: Tell us if it includes batteries, liquids, powders or regulated items.

items.title: Exact addresses
items.text: For pickup and delivery, with a contact person at each point.

items.title: Vehicle type
items.text: Van, truck or another, if you already know which one your cargo needs.

items.title: Loading and unloading hours
items.text: And any access restrictions at the delivery points.

ready.title: Ready to get a quote?
ready.text: Fill in the form with what you have and we'll reply by email. You can also write to {email}.

steps.title: You tell us what you ship
steps.text: With the details above, through the form or by email.

steps.title: You receive your quote
steps.text: We compare rates with carriers and partners, and send you a clear proposal.

steps.title: We approve and operate
steps.text: With your go-ahead, we coordinate pickup, transport and customs procedures.

steps.title: We deliver and keep you informed
steps.text: We keep you posted until the cargo reaches its destination.
